description: Flat metadata schema for X-ray phase-contrast microscopy datasets of cultured human epithelial cells exposed to ionizing radiation, including irradiation, sample preparation, imaging acquisition, and processing provenance.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the dataset record, image, or specimen instance.

specimen_id.descr: Identifier linking multiple images or measurements from the same biological specimen or culture well.

cell_line.descr: Human epithelial cell line name or other epithelial model used, for example HeLa, A549, HaCaT.

cell_origin.descr: Biological source/origin of the cells, including donor information if applicable.

culture_format.descr: Culture configuration, for example monolayer, on-grid culture, chambered slide, or microfluidic device.

culture_surface_coating.descr: Substrate or coating used to promote cell attachment, for example collagen, poly-L-lysine, fibronectin, or none.

seeding_density_cells_per_cm2.descr: Initial cell seeding density in cells per square centimeter.

culture_medium.descr: Complete culture medium formulation used during growth and/or imaging preparation.

serum_percent.descr: Serum concentration in culture medium, expressed as percent volume/volume.

incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature in degrees Celsius during culture or treatment.

co2_percent.descr: Carbon dioxide concentration used during incubation, expressed as percent.

humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity during culture/incubation, expressed as percent.

confluency_percent.descr: Estimated cell confluency at the time of irradiation or imaging, expressed as percent.

radiation_type.descr: Ionizing radiation modality, for example X-ray, gamma, proton, or electron.

radiation_dose_gy.descr: Absorbed dose delivered to the sample in gray (Gy).

radiation_dose_rate_gy_per_min.descr: Dose rate in gray per minute, if available.

radiation_energy_kev.descr: Radiation beam energy in kilo-electronvolts (keV), if applicable.

radiation_source_name.descr: Name of the irradiation source or facility.

radiation_source_model.descr: Model or identifier of the irradiation device, source, or beamline.

irradiation_geometry.descr: Geometry of irradiation, for example broad beam, collimated beam, single-field, or multi-field.

sample_to_source_distance_mm.descr: Distance from source to sample in millimeters, if relevant.

sample_to_detector_distance_mm.descr: Distance from sample to detector in millimeters during imaging, if relevant.

irradiation_time_min.descr: Duration of irradiation exposure in minutes.

time_post_irradiation_h.descr: Time elapsed between irradiation and imaging in hours.

fixation_used.descr: Whether the sample was chemically fixed before imaging.

fixative_type.descr: Fixative used, for example paraformaldehyde, glutaraldehyde, methanol, or none.

fixative_concentration_percent.descr: Fixative concentration expressed as percent, if applicable.

dehydration_used.descr: Whether a dehydration step was performed.

dehydration_series.descr: Description of dehydration series, for example ethanol gradient or critical-point drying.

embedding_medium.descr: Embedding medium used, for example resin, paraffin, or none.

sample_mounting_method.descr: How the sample was mounted for imaging, for example on grid, slide, capillary, or holder type.

staining_contrast_agent.descr: Any contrast agent or stain used, for example osmium tetroxide, uranyl acetate, phosphotungstic acid, or none.

stain_concentration_percent.descr: Stain concentration expressed as percent, if applicable.

microscope_type.descr: X-ray microscopy modality used, for example phase-contrast microscope, transmission X-ray microscope, or ptychographic microscope.

instrument_name.descr: Instrument name or facility identifier for the microscope.

beamline_id.descr: Beamline or endstation identifier, if applicable.

xray_source_type.descr: X-ray source type, for example synchrotron, laboratory source, or microfocus source.

xray_monochromated.descr: Whether the X-ray beam was monochromated.

xray_wavelength_nm.descr: X-ray wavelength in nanometers, if known.

objective_magnification.descr: Optical or effective magnification used for imaging.

pixel_size_nm.descr: Effective detector pixel size at the sample plane in nanometers.

field_of_view_um.descr: Imaged field of view in micrometers, if applicable.

exposure_time_ms.descr: Exposure time per frame in milliseconds.

number_of_frames.descr: Number of frames or projections acquired for this record.

detector_model.descr: Detector name or model used for image acquisition.

detector_type.descr: Detector type, for example CCD, sCMOS, hybrid pixel detector, or scintillator-coupled detector.

detector_binning.descr: Detector binning factor used during acquisition.

phase_contrast_method.descr: Phase-contrast technique used, for example propagation-based, Zernike, inline holography, or grating interferometry.

propagation_distance_mm.descr: Propagation distance used for phase-contrast imaging in millimeters, if applicable.

focus_to_sample_distance_mm.descr: Distance from focal point to sample in millimeters, if applicable.

temperature_during_imaging_c.descr: Sample temperature during imaging in degrees Celsius.

live_cell_imaging.descr: Whether the cells were imaged alive rather than fixed.

environment_controlled.descr: Whether environmental control such as temperature, CO2, or humidity regulation was used during imaging.

raw_file_name.descr: Name of the raw image file or file set associated with the record.

raw_file_format.descr: Raw image file format, for example TIFF, HDF5, EDF, CBF, or proprietary format.

processing_workflow_name.descr: Name of the image processing workflow or pipeline.

processing_software_name.descr: Primary software used for image processing or analysis.

processing_software_version.descr: Version of the software used for processing.

processing_algorithm.descr: Main algorithm used, for example phase retrieval, denoising, flat-field correction, or segmentation method.

phase_retrieval_method.descr: Phase retrieval method used, if applicable.

image_registration_used.descr: Whether image registration or alignment was applied.

image_correlation_method.descr: Method used for image correlation across time points, channels, or modalities, for example cross-correlation, feature-based registration, mutual information, or landmark-based alignment.

segmentation_software.descr: Software used for segmentation, if any.

analysis_metrics.descr: Primary quantitative outputs derived from the image, for example organelle area, cytoskeletal density, texture features, or morphology scores.

quality_control_passed.descr: Whether the record passed quality-control criteria.

quality_control_notes.descr: Free-text notes on image quality, artifacts, or exclusions.

operator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person who performed imaging or processing.

acquisition_date.descr: Date of image acquisition or irradiation, in ISO 8601 format where applicable.

processing_date.descr: Date of image processing or analysis, in ISO 8601 format where applicable.
